mission.name: Apollo 11
mission.purpose: Perform the first crewed lunar landing and return the crew safely to Earth.

crew.name: Neil A. Armstrong
crew.responsibility: Commanded the mission and piloted Eagle during the lunar landing. He and Aldrin worked on the lunar surface.

crew.name: Michael Collins
crew.responsibility: Piloted Columbia and remained in lunar orbit while Armstrong and Aldrin were on the surface.

crew.name: Edwin “Buzz” Aldrin Jr.
crew.responsibility: Piloted lunar-module systems and worked with Armstrong during the landing and lunar surface activity.

spacecraft.name: Saturn V AS-506
spacecraft.function: Placed Apollo 11 into Earth orbit and sent the spacecraft toward the Moon.

spacecraft.name: Columbia
spacecraft.function: Served as the crew’s principal spacecraft during most of the mission. The command module was the only crewed part to return through Earth’s atmosphere.

spacecraft.name: Eagle
spacecraft.function: Carried Armstrong and Aldrin from lunar orbit to the surface and returned its ascent stage to rendezvous with Columbia.

milestones.title: Launch
milestones.summary: Saturn V launched Apollo 11 from Launch Pad 39A at 9:32 a.m. EDT.

milestones.title: Earth orbit and translunar injection
milestones.summary: After reaching Earth orbit, the S-IVB stage restarted to send the spacecraft toward the Moon. Columbia separated, turned, docked with Eagle, and extracted it from the adapter.

milestones.title: Lunar orbit
milestones.summary: Apollo 11 entered lunar orbit. Armstrong and Aldrin prepared Eagle while Collins continued operating Columbia.

milestones.title: Eagle separates
milestones.summary: Eagle separated from Columbia for the powered descent. Collins remained aboard Columbia in lunar orbit.

milestones.title: Lunar landing
milestones.summary: Armstrong and Aldrin landed Eagle in the Sea of Tranquility.

milestones.title: Surface activity
milestones.summary: Armstrong and Aldrin explored the landing area, photographed their work, collected samples, and deployed experiments.

milestones.title: Ascent and rendezvous
milestones.summary: Eagle’s ascent stage lifted from the Moon and reunited with Columbia in lunar orbit. The crew and samples transferred before Eagle was released.

milestones.title: Return to Earth
milestones.summary: Columbia left lunar orbit, crossed back to Earth, separated from the service module, and entered the atmosphere.

milestones.title: Splashdown and recovery
milestones.summary: The command module splashed down in the Pacific Ocean and the crew was recovered by USS Hornet.

artifacts.title: Apollo 11 flight plan
artifacts.description: A procedural record of the mission sequence, crew activity, communications, and spacecraft operations.

artifacts.title: Apollo 11 mission report
artifacts.description: A post-mission record covering objectives, operations, systems performance, anomalies, and results.

artifacts.title: Apollo 11 Lunar Surface Journal
artifacts.description: A time-ordered archive of surface communications, commentary, photographs, and mission documentation.

artifacts.title: Lunar sample record
artifacts.description: Returned rock and soil samples linked the landing site to laboratory study on Earth.

artifacts.title: Laser Ranging Retroreflector
artifacts.description: A reflector array placed on the Moon that supports laser-ranging measurements from Earth.
